title: Feedback line
description: One piece of user feedback on a product's output, from /po-feedback in chat or a pull request comment in the products repo. JSON Lines, UTF-8, append-only, stored at <product>/.po/feedback.jsonl. A feedback line is never edited; its status is worked out from the lines that refer to it: traced once an attribution names it (attribution.schema.json), fixed once a done rerun names it (rerun.schema.json), learned once a ledger entry names it (ledger.schema.json), or withdrawn by a later line with the same id and withdrawn true. Each feedback line also gets a register line of type feedback (register.schema.json) so po's catch-up shows it.

x-categories.wrong-or-invented: States something nobody said, or something false. Includes invented content: a requirement, actor, figure or quote with no source.
x-categories.missing: Leaves out an actor, system, requirement, risk, step or other item that should be there.
x-categories.misunderstood-intent: Took what the user said and recorded a different meaning: we said X, I meant Y.
x-categories.wrong-scope-or-priority: In when it should be out, out when it should be in, or the wrong priority (a Should written as a Must).
x-categories.unclear-or-untestable: Vague words, more than one requirement in one, no acceptance criteria, or a criterion nobody could test.
x-categories.inconsistent: Contradicts another output, the glossary, or a locked decision in the register.
x-categories.wrong-for-audience: Right content, wrong tone, depth, language or format for the person it is for.
x-categories.process: About how po worked, not about one item: too many questions, a leading question, a skipped gate, an unasked OK.
x-categories.not-sure: Feels wrong but the user cannot say why. The tracer asks the user one follow-up question before attributing it.

id.description: FB-<number>, numbered per product in order from FB-001.

by.description: Who gave it: a name or a GitHub login. Optional.

target.description: What the feedback is about. A run or a process point names the run; an artefact names the file; a section names the file and heading; an item or a quote names item IDs.

item_revs.description: The rev of each item when the feedback was given, so it stays attached to the version it was about.

quote.description: The exact sentence or words the feedback is about.

severity.description: P0 blocks use: acting on it would cause real harm or a wrong build. P1 wrong. P2 weak: right but thin, vague or poorly argued. P3 polish.

category.description: What is wrong. The nine values are explained in x-categories.

expected.description: What it should say or do instead, if the user said.

pr.description: For source pr-comment: where the comment is. comment_id keeps the same comment from being taken in twice.

withdrawn.description: Set on a later line with the same id when the user takes the feedback back.
